turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here? Owen's essay got a zero, and nobody called me first.
Let's not waste each other's time.
Agreed. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
It's a machine's guess, and the company that sells it says not to rely on it alone. What else do you have besides that number?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
I'm here as Owen's mother. Now, what else do you have?
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm writing those times down. Did Owen see that before the zero went in, or after?
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
A misquote is a mistake, not a machine. Show me the page it's on, and answer what I asked: did Owen see any of this before the zero?
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Skip the compliments. You still haven't answered whether Owen saw any of this before the zero.
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
Hale, answer the question. Before the zero, or after?
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
Writing your policy is your job, not mine. You already have one, and it says a parent gets called before any mark goes in. Nobody called me.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
I'm not drafting anything for you. I'm here about Owen's essay, and you've now dodged my question four times. Before the zero, or after?
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
That's an impression, Hale, and I don't take impressions. Is there a document, or isn't there?
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen's essay, and whether he saw any of this before the zero.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?
Students change their argument between an outline and a final draft; that's what drafting is. Put the outline next to the essay and show me both.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
That's 4.4, and it goes in writing. But a rewrite for what? You haven't put one page in front of me.
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Then walk, Hale, and I'll be at the principal's office next. Or put the outline, the file history and the quote in front of me, and we keep talking.
